shots.desc: Over the page at dusk, the sky darkening: a quiet garden with a tomb in a rock and a big round stone across its door, a path, a house with an upstairs room. Two women stand by the closed tomb, heads bowed; upstairs, Peter and John sit very still on the bench. No cross is shown anywhere.
Dawn: pink and gold sky, birds. Mary Magdalene and her friend Joanna walk along the path from the town to the garden, each carrying a small jar of sweet spices, wondering about the stone.

In front of the tomb the ground rumbles gently; a flash of white light; when it clears, the big stone has rolled to one side and a shining angel sits on top of it, legs dangling, smiling. The women gasp.

The angel, seated on the stone, speaks kindly to the women and points to the open door. They step up and peek in: a soft light inside, only the folded linen cloths on the stone ledge. The tomb is empty.
The upstairs room, morning light. Peter and John sit sadly on the bench along the back wall. Mary bursts in through the side door, breathless, and tells them; they jump up.
Peter and John run along the path to the garden, dust puffing at their feet. Young John is quicker and pulls ahead, waving Peter on; Peter puffs along behind, red-faced.
John reaches the tomb first and stops at the door, peeking in. Peter puffs up behind him and goes straight in, bending under the low doorway. Light inside; the linen cloths lie folded on the ledge.
Later. Mary stands alone in the garden by the flowers, crying, her eyes so full of tears she cannot see clearly. A man stands quietly behind her: it is Jesus, but she thinks He is the gardener.

Jesus says her name. Mary looks up and knows Him at once; she runs to Him and takes His hands, laughing and crying together. Butterflies rise from the flowers; warm sunlight. Then she runs off to tell.

Evening in the upstairs room, lamps lit, the door locked. Mary tells Peter and John that she has seen Jesus. Suddenly Jesus is standing right there with them. They jump; John thinks He is a ghost. Jesus laughs, holds out His hands, and eats a piece of fish to show He is real.

A week later, the same room. Thomas, who was not there, stands with his arms crossed, shaking his head. Jesus appears again, turns to him and holds out His hands; Thomas gently touches them and kneels with joy.
The whole page in bright morning sun: the open, empty tomb glowing softly, butterflies over the flowers. Jesus stands in the garden with His friends round Him, all smiling and waving to the child.

lines.zh: 有人把耶稣抓走了，耶稣死在了十字架上。天黑了下来，他的朋友们好难过。
lines.en: Some men took Jesus away, and He died on a cross. The sky went dark, and His friends were very sad.
lines.dir: soft and slow, plain; no drama, no pause on the cross; a gentle hush on 好难过 / 'very, very sad'

lines.zh: 朋友们把耶稣安放在花园里的坟墓里，一块又大又圆的石头挡住了门。
lines.en: His friends laid Him in a tomb in a garden, and a big round stone was rolled across the door.
lines.dir: quiet, tender; a small weight on 又大又圆 / 'big round'

lines.zh: 可是，耶稣说过：“第三天，我要复活！”
lines.en: But Jesus had made a promise: 'On the third day, I will rise again!'
lines.dir: the turn of the story: lift and brighten, a little secret smile; slower on 第三天 / 'the third day'

lines.zh: 第三天一大早，马利亚和她的朋友约亚拿带着香膏，往花园走去。
lines.en: Very early on the third day, Mary Magdalene and her friend Joanna carried sweet spices to the garden.
lines.dir: morning-fresh, a hint of hope; unhurried

lines.zh: 那块石头那么大，谁能帮我们滚开呢？
lines.en: That stone is so big! Who will roll it away for us?
lines.dir: worried but practical, a little out of breath from walking

lines.zh: 我也不知道……我只是想离耶稣近一点。
lines.en: I don't know... I just want to be near Jesus.
lines.dir: soft, a little sad, loving

lines.zh: 忽然，地动了一下，大石头滚开了！一位天使坐在上面，全身发亮，像闪电一样！
lines.en: Suddenly the ground shook, and the big stone rolled away! An angel sat on it, shining like lightning!
lines.dir: wonder, building quickly; not scary; a delighted lift on 滚开了 / 'rolled away'

lines.zh: 石头……滚开了！
lines.en: The stone... it's rolled away!
lines.dir: a breathless, amazed whisper

lines.zh: 不要害怕！耶稣不在这里，他复活了，就像他说过的！
lines.en: Don't be afraid! Jesus is not here. He is risen, just as He said!
lines.dir: kind, strong and calm, a big smile in the voice; the heart of the story: slow and joyful on 他复活了 / 'He is risen'

lines.zh: 来，看看安放他的地方。
lines.en: Come and see the place where He lay.
lines.dir: gentle invitation

lines.zh: 真的空了！只有叠好的细麻布！
lines.en: It's empty! There's only the cloth, folded up!
lines.dir: amazed, rising to joy

lines.zh: 快去告诉他的朋友们：耶稣活了！
lines.en: Hurry! Go and tell His friends: Jesus is alive!
lines.dir: bright, urgent in a happy way

lines.zh: 彼得！约翰！坟墓空了！天使说，耶稣复活了！
lines.en: Peter! John! The tomb is empty! An angel said Jesus is alive!
lines.dir: breathless, tumbling out fast, bursting with joy

lines.zh: 复活了？这……这怎么可能？
lines.en: Alive? That... that can't be true!
lines.dir: stunned, big and blustery; half hoping

lines.zh: 彼得，别站着了，快去看看！
lines.en: Peter, don't just stand there! Let's go and see!
lines.dir: young, quick, already moving

lines.zh: 彼得和约翰拼命地跑。可是约翰年轻，跑得比彼得快！
lines.en: Peter and John ran as fast as they could. But John was younger, and he ran faster than Peter!
lines.dir: lively, quick; a grin on 跑得比彼得快 / 'faster than Peter'

lines.zh: 快点儿，彼得！
lines.en: Hurry up, Peter!
lines.dir: cheeky, calling back over his shoulder

lines.zh: 等……等等我！我的腿……没你的年轻！
lines.en: Wait... wait for me! My legs... aren't as young as yours!
lines.dir: puffing and panting between the words, comic; a laugh in it

lines.zh: 约翰先到，往里看。彼得呼哧呼哧赶到，一头钻了进去！
lines.en: John got there first and looked in. Then Peter came puffing up and went straight inside!
lines.dir: playful storyteller; a comic beat on 一头钻了进去 / 'went straight inside'

lines.zh: 细麻布还在这儿，叠得整整齐齐……可是耶稣不在！
lines.en: The cloths are here, folded up neatly... but Jesus isn't!
lines.dir: half inside the doorway, puzzled wonder; the last words a hushed gasp

lines.zh: 他说过他会复活……他真的做到了！
lines.en: He said He would rise again... and He did!
lines.dir: the penny drops: slow wonder, then a happy rush

lines.zh: 后来，马利亚回到花园。她太想耶稣了，一直在哭。
lines.en: Later, Mary came back to the garden. She missed Jesus so much, she cried and cried.
lines.dir: tender, slow; a soft ache, not heavy

lines.zh: 你为什么哭？你在找谁呢？
lines.en: Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?
lines.dir: very gentle, warm, a hidden smile (He knows!)

lines.zh: 先生，你是看园子的吧？要是你把他搬走了，请告诉我放在哪里！
lines.en: Sir, are you the gardener? If you took Him away, please tell me where He is!
lines.dir: tearful, not looking up, earnest; a small comic innocence in 看园子的 / 'the gardener'

lines.zh: 马利亚。
lines.en: Mary.
lines.dir: one word, soft and full of love, the way only He says it

lines.zh: 老师！是你！真的是你！
lines.en: Teacher! It's You! It's really You!
lines.dir: a gasp, then pure joy, laughing through tears

lines.zh: 去告诉我的朋友们：我活着！
lines.en: Go and tell My friends: I am alive!
lines.dir: warm, glad, a bright smile

lines.zh: 我真的看见耶稣了！他活着！他叫了我的名字！
lines.en: I really saw Jesus! He's alive! He said my name!
lines.dir: glowing, sure, happy

lines.zh: 门关得紧紧的，可是忽然，耶稣就站在他们中间！
lines.en: The door was locked tight. But suddenly, Jesus was standing right there!
lines.dir: hushed, then a magical lift on 忽然 / 'Suddenly'

lines.zh: 愿你们平安！
lines.en: Peace be with you!
lines.dir: warm, calm, smiling, arms open

lines.zh: 鬼……鬼啊？
lines.en: A g-g-ghost?
lines.dir: squeaky, teeth chattering, comic, not truly scared

lines.zh: 哈哈，是我呀！鬼可没有手和脚。你们有吃的吗？
lines.en: Ha ha, it's Me! A ghost doesn't have hands and feet. Got anything to eat?
lines.dir: laughing warmly, playful; the food question light and homely

lines.zh: 哈哈！他在吃我们的鱼！真的是耶稣！
lines.en: Ha ha! He's eating our fish! It really is Jesus!
lines.dir: a big delighted belly laugh, tears of joy

lines.zh: 一个星期以后。那天晚上多马不在，大家告诉他，他直摇头。
lines.en: A week later. Thomas had not been there that night, and when they told him, he shook his head.
lines.dir: plain storyteller, a little knowing smile

lines.zh: 除非我亲眼看见他的手，我才信！
lines.en: Unless I see His hands myself, I won't believe it!
lines.dir: stubborn but not grumpy; arms crossed; a small frown

lines.zh: 多马，来看看我的手，摸一摸。不要疑惑，要信！
lines.en: Thomas, look at My hands. Touch them. Don't doubt: believe!
lines.dir: very gentle, patient, a loving invitation; no reproach

lines.zh: 我的主！我的上帝！
lines.en: My Lord and my God!
lines.dir: overwhelmed, a happy sob of faith; from the heart

lines.zh: 耶稣死了，可是死亡留不住他。他复活了，今天还活着！
lines.en: Jesus died, but death could not keep Him. He rose again, and He is alive today!
lines.dir: joyful and sure, straight to the child; slow and clear

lines.zh: 耶稣说到做到。他还说：“我天天和你们在一起。”
lines.en: Jesus always keeps His promises. And He said: 'I am with you always.'
lines.dir: warm, a smile, a hush on the promise at the end
